legal_request_templates.purpose: Identification of account holder for fraud investigation

standard_content.subject: Legal Disclosure Request under Section 69 of IT Act 2000
standard_content.body: We, the Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C), request KYC information for the following wallet address: [WALLET_ADDRESS]. This is in connection with [CASE_ID] and is required for investigation under [APPLICABLE_LAW]. Please provide information within 7 days as per legal requirements.

standard_content.subject: URGENT: Request for Freezing of Crypto Assets
standard_content.body: We request immediate freezing of [AMOUNT] [CURRENCY] at wallet address [WALLET_ADDRESS]. This is linked to fraud investigation [CASE_ID] under Section [APPLICABLE_LAW]. Please freeze all assets and provide KYC details of the account holder.
